decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles used on Delaware highways must ____.
cards.back: Vehicles used on Delaware highways must be registered.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: New Delaware residents have sixty days after moving to title ____.
cards.back: New Delaware residents have sixty days after moving to title and register their vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A Delaware-registered automobile needs at least two white multibeam headlights, with ____.
cards.back: A Delaware-registered automobile needs at least two white multibeam headlights, with one on either front side.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: High beams must illuminate people and vehicles at a distance of at ____.
cards.back: High beams must illuminate people and vehicles at a distance of at least three hundred fifty feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Low beams must illuminate people at least one hundred feet ahead without ____.
cards.back: Low beams must illuminate people at least one hundred feet ahead without shining into an approaching driver’s eyes.
cards.memory_hook: shining into an approaching driver’s eyes

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Headlights must operate while the wipers are used ____.
cards.back: Headlights must operate while the wipers are used because of bad weather.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The rear must have at least two red taillights of the original ____.
cards.back: The rear must have at least two red taillights of the original design, visible at five hundred feet.
cards.memory_hook: design, visible at five hundred feet

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At least one front parking light must be white or amber and ____.
cards.back: At least one front parking light must be white or amber and visible at five hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At least one rear parking light must be red and visible at five hundred feet; ____.
cards.back: At least one rear parking light must be red and visible at five hundred feet; a taillight can serve this purpose.
cards.memory_hook: a taillight can serve this purpose

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The registration-plate light must be white and make the number ____.
cards.back: The registration-plate light must be white and make the number readable at fifty feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The plate light must not cast light toward vehicles proceeding ____.
cards.back: The plate light must not cast light toward vehicles proceeding in the same direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A rear stop light of the original design must be amber, red, ____.
cards.back: A rear stop light of the original design must be amber, red, or a shade between them.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A stop light must illuminate with brake-pedal use and remain visible at least one ____.
cards.back: A stop light must illuminate with brake-pedal use and remain visible at least one hundred feet away in normal sunlight.
cards.memory_hook: hundred feet away in normal sunlight

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a vehicle has two stop lights, ____.
cards.back: When a vehicle has two stop lights, both must operate.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles made after nineteen fifty-three need two front and ____.
cards.back: Vehicles made after nineteen fifty-three need two front and two rear turn signals.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Front turn-signal colors may range from ____.
cards.back: Front turn-signal colors may range from white through amber.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Rear turn-signal colors may range from ____.
cards.back: Rear turn-signal colors may range from amber through red.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Both turn-signal sets must be visible at one hundred feet ____.
cards.back: Both turn-signal sets must be visible at one hundred feet or more in normal sunlight.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Turn signals fitted to vehicles made in nineteen fifty-three ____.
cards.back: Turn signals fitted to vehicles made in nineteen fifty-three or earlier must function.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passenger vehicles made after nineteen fifty-three need two ____.
cards.back: Passenger vehicles made after nineteen fifty-three need two red rear reflectors.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles made after nineteen seventy-seven need at least six reflectors: amber at each front side, red at each rear side, ____.
cards.back: Vehicles made after nineteen seventy-seven need at least six reflectors: amber at each front side, red at each rear side, and two red at the rear.
cards.memory_hook: and two red at the rear

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Reflectors require four square inches of reflecting area and visibility ____.
cards.back: Reflectors require four square inches of reflecting area and visibility at five hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Reflectors can be built into ____.
cards.back: Reflectors can be built into lamp lenses.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passenger vehicles made since nineteen seventy-two need side markers: two amber toward the front sides and ____.
cards.back: Passenger vehicles made since nineteen seventy-two need side markers: two amber toward the front sides and two red toward the rear sides.
cards.memory_hook: two red toward the rear sides

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Side-marker lamps require four square inches of luminous lens area and ____.
cards.back: Side-marker lamps require four square inches of luminous lens area and visibility at five hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicle brakes must act evenly on every side and ____.
cards.back: Vehicle brakes must act evenly on every side and satisfy federal braking standards.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The parking or emergency brake must halt the vehicle from twenty miles ____.
cards.back: The parking or emergency brake must halt the vehicle from twenty miles per hour within fifty-four feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The windshield and all side and rear windows must ____.
cards.back: The windshield and all side and rear windows must use automotive safety glass.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Window stickers and signs are limited to legally required ____.
cards.back: Window stickers and signs are limited to legally required certificates or DMV-approved items.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Windshield wipers must clear rain, snow ____.
cards.back: Windshield wipers must clear rain, snow and other moisture.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A rear-view mirror must let the driver see vehicles moving ____.
cards.back: A rear-view mirror must let the driver see vehicles moving in the same direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If the interior mirror’s rearward view is obstructed, outside mirrors ____.
cards.back: If the interior mirror’s rearward view is obstructed, outside mirrors are required on both sides.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Every vehicle needs a functioning muffler kept ____.
cards.back: Every vehicle needs a functioning muffler kept in continuous operation.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicle noise must meet federal standards, and excessive or ____.
cards.back: Vehicle noise must meet federal standards, and excessive or loud noise is prohibited.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The horn must be audible at least two hundred feet ____.
cards.back: The horn must be audible at least two hundred feet away under normal conditions.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passenger cars made after January one, nineteen sixty-eight need belts ____.
cards.back: Passenger cars made after January one, nineteen sixty-eight need belts for every front-seat occupant.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Trucks, buses and multipassenger vehicles made after July one, nineteen seventy-one need ____.
cards.back: Trucks, buses and multipassenger vehicles made after July one, nineteen seventy-one need belts for every front-seat occupant.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A vehicle may carry two spotlights, but their intense beams must not aim left or ____.
cards.back: A vehicle may carry two spotlights, but their intense beams must not aim left or farther than one hundred feet ahead.
cards.memory_hook: farther than one hundred feet ahead

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A vehicle may carry two white or yellow front fog lamps mounted ____.
cards.back: A vehicle may carry two white or yellow front fog lamps mounted twelve to thirty inches above ground.
cards.memory_hook: twelve to thirty inches above ground

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A fog-lamp beam must fall at least four inches over ____.
cards.back: A fog-lamp beam must fall at least four inches over its first twenty-five feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Rear backing lamps may use shades ranging from ____.
cards.back: Rear backing lamps may use shades ranging from white to amber.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Colored lighting beyond factory equipment, marker lamps and turn signals ____.
cards.back: Colored lighting beyond factory equipment, marker lamps and turn signals is reserved for emergency vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: No more than four front lamps rated at least three hundred ____.
cards.back: No more than four front lamps rated at least three hundred candlepower may be illuminated simultaneously.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The center of a headlamp must sit between twenty-four and ____.
cards.back: The center of a headlamp must sit between twenty-four and fifty-four inches above ground.

decks.module: Lighting restrictions and appropriate beam use (A)
decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A red light visible from the front is prohibited on an ordinary ____.
cards.back: A red light visible from the front is prohibited on an ordinary motor vehicle; emergency vehicles are excepted.
cards.memory_hook: motor vehicle; emergency vehicles are excepted

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Emergency vehicles, school buses and snow-removal equipment are among the exceptions ____.
cards.back: Emergency vehicles, school buses and snow-removal equipment are among the exceptions to the general flashing-light prohibition.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Snow-removal equipment may use green revolving ____.
cards.back: Snow-removal equipment may use green revolving or flashing lights.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Turn signals and four-way hazard flashers are ____.
cards.back: Turn signals and four-way hazard flashers are permitted flashing-light uses.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Unauthorized additions such as frames, symbols or accessories on a ____.
cards.back: Unauthorized additions such as frames, symbols or accessories on a license plate are forbidden.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A lamp or reflector must not be installed if it tends to alter ____.
cards.back: A lamp or reflector must not be installed if it tends to alter the vehicle’s original design or performance.
cards.memory_hook: the vehicle’s original design or performance

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Studded tires are allowed in Delaware from October fifteen through ____.
cards.back: Studded tires are allowed in Delaware from October fifteen through April fifteen, including both endpoints.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Studded tires are prohibited in Delaware from April sixteen through October fourteen; drivers must follow ____.
cards.back: Studded tires are prohibited in Delaware from April sixteen through October fourteen; drivers must follow other states’ rules while traveling there.
cards.memory_hook: other states’ rules while traveling there

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Using a muffler cut-out ____.
cards.back: Using a muffler cut-out is forbidden.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Ordinary vehicles may not carry a siren or an ____.
cards.back: Ordinary vehicles may not carry a siren or an exhaust or compression whistle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A motor vehicle generally may tow only one vehicle; a tractor with a ____.
cards.back: A motor vehicle generally may tow only one vehicle; a tractor with a semitrailer may tow one additional vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: semitrailer may tow one additional vehicle

decks.module: Lighting restrictions and appropriate beam use (B)
decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The connection between towing and towed vehicles must measure no ____.
cards.back: The connection between towing and towed vehicles must measure no more than fifteen feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A chain, cable or rope used for towing needs an attached red ____.
cards.back: A chain, cable or rope used for towing needs an attached red flag at least twelve inches square.
cards.memory_hook: flag at least twelve inches square

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The windshield tint restriction covers the area below the upper five inches, with the source ____.
cards.back: The windshield tint restriction covers the area below the upper five inches, with the source also referring to an AS-one boundary.
cards.memory_hook: also referring to an AS-one boundary

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Tint material must not cover vehicle lights or ____.
cards.back: Tint material must not cover vehicle lights or the license plate.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A vehicle fitted with tint needs exterior mirrors on its ____.
cards.back: A vehicle fitted with tint needs exterior mirrors on its left and right sides.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Aftermarket tint immediately beside the driver requires a valid approved ____.
cards.back: Aftermarket tint immediately beside the driver requires a valid approved waiver kept in the vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Headlights must be used during driving between ____.
cards.back: Headlights must be used during driving between sunset and sunrise.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Headlights are required whenever visibility does not extend ____.
cards.back: Headlights are required whenever visibility does not extend beyond one thousand feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The headlight-use subsection requires headlights whenever the windshield ____.
cards.back: The headlight-use subsection requires headlights whenever the windshield wipers are used.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Use low beams beginning five hundred feet before ____.
cards.back: Use low beams beginning five hundred feet before meeting another vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Use low beams when following within two hundred ____.
cards.back: Use low beams when following within two hundred feet of another vehicle.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Every vehicle occupant must be secured correctly by a belt ____.
cards.back: Every vehicle occupant must be secured correctly by a belt or child safety seat.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An officer may stop a vehicle upon seeing an ____.
cards.back: An officer may stop a vehicle upon seeing an occupant without a belt.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The driver is ticketed for occupants who are ____.
cards.back: The driver is ticketed for occupants who are unrestrained or restrained incorrectly.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Obtaining liability insurance from an insurer licensed to operate in Delaware establishes the owner’s ____.
cards.back: Obtaining liability insurance from an insurer licensed to operate in Delaware establishes the owner’s financial responsibility for titling and registration.
cards.memory_hook: financial responsibility for titling and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Minimum personal-injury protection is fifteen thousand dollars for one person ____.
cards.back: Minimum personal-injury protection is fifteen thousand dollars for one person injured in a crash.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Minimum personal-injury protection is thirty thousand dollars for all people ____.
cards.back: Minimum personal-injury protection is thirty thousand dollars for all people injured in one crash.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Minimum liability coverage for one person’s bodily injury or death in a ____.
cards.back: Minimum liability coverage for one person’s bodily injury or death in a crash is twenty-five thousand dollars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Minimum liability coverage for bodily injury or death of at least two people in ____.
cards.back: Minimum liability coverage for bodily injury or death of at least two people in a crash is fifty thousand dollars.
cards.memory_hook: a crash is fifty thousand dollars

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Minimum coverage for damage to other people’s property in a ____.
cards.back: Minimum coverage for damage to other people’s property in a crash is ten thousand dollars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An original Delaware insurance identification card is an acceptable insurance document and ____.
cards.back: An original Delaware insurance identification card is an acceptable insurance document and may be electronic or paper.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The insurance card must stay in the vehicle and show coverage dates, a valid ____.
cards.back: The insurance card must stay in the vehicle and show coverage dates, a valid expiration and the insurer’s NAIC code.
cards.memory_hook: expiration and the insurer’s NAIC code

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Insurance identification cards are issued again ____.
cards.back: Insurance identification cards are issued again every six months.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A valid insurance policy is accepted as ____.
cards.back: A valid insurance policy is accepted as proof of coverage.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A written binder is acceptable within thirty days after issue when supplied by an insurer ____.
cards.back: A written binder is acceptable within thirty days after issue when supplied by an insurer or agent on the insurer’s letterhead.
cards.memory_hook: or agent on the insurer’s letterhead

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Faxed insurance proof is accepted only when the insurer sends it directly to the ____.
cards.back: Faxed insurance proof is accepted only when the insurer sends it directly to the DMV; a third-party fax is rejected.
cards.memory_hook: DMV; a third-party fax is rejected

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Electronic insurance proof is subject ____.
cards.back: Electronic insurance proof is subject to verification.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Driving an uninsured vehicle carries a fine from one thousand five hundred ____.
cards.back: Driving an uninsured vehicle carries a fine from one thousand five hundred dollars to two thousand dollars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A later uninsured-driving offense within three years of an earlier offense carries a three thousand ____.
cards.back: A later uninsured-driving offense within three years of an earlier offense carries a three thousand dollars to four thousand dollars fine.
cards.memory_hook: dollars to four thousand dollars fine

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: False insurance proof brings an additional five hundred dollars fine, thirty ____.
cards.back: False insurance proof brings an additional five hundred dollars fine, thirty days in jail, or both.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After proper notice to the owner, authorized insurance personnel or law-enforcement officials may take the plate ____.
cards.back: After proper notice to the owner, authorized insurance personnel or law-enforcement officials may take the plate when affirmative insurance proof is absent.
cards.memory_hook: when affirmative insurance proof is absent

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before canceling insurance, the owner must surrender a valid plate to ____.
cards.back: Before canceling insurance, the owner must surrender a valid plate to the DMV or face fines.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The DMV conducts random insurance-proof audits ____.
cards.back: The DMV conducts random insurance-proof audits of active registrations.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The insurance-audit penalty is one hundred dollars for the first one to thirty uninsured days, then five dollars daily until ____.
cards.back: The insurance-audit penalty is one hundred dollars for the first one to thirty uninsured days, then five dollars daily until insurance, tag surrender or registration expiration.
cards.memory_hook: insurance, tag surrender or registration expiration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An owner’s failure to answer an insurance-audit request ____.
cards.back: An owner’s failure to answer an insurance-audit request results in registration suspension.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Reinstating a suspended registration after the insurance-audit process costs ____.
cards.back: Reinstating a suspended registration after the insurance-audit process costs fifty dollars per registration.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicle inspection is the second step in the Delaware ____.
cards.back: Vehicle inspection is the second step in the Delaware title and registration process.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A title certificate or registration card must be ____.
cards.back: A title certificate or registration card must be presented for inspection.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Delaware residents are not charged for ____.
cards.back: Delaware residents are not charged for vehicle inspection.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Inspection requires lamps to work, be clean and ____.
cards.back: Inspection requires lamps to work, be clean and have correct aim.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Every vehicle brought for inspection receives ____.
cards.back: Every vehicle brought for inspection receives a brake-performance test.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Inspection mirrors must be intact ____.
cards.back: Inspection mirrors must be intact and clean.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Inspection wipers must work fully and have ____.
cards.back: Inspection wipers must work fully and have sound rubber blades.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Hood and trunk latches must keep their ____.
cards.back: Hood and trunk latches must keep their panels completely closed.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Inspection tires may not have cuts, bulges, bald ____.
cards.back: Inspection tires may not have cuts, bulges, bald patches or exposed fabric.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Inspection tread depth must reach at least two thirty-seconds inch ____.
cards.back: Inspection tread depth must reach at least two thirty-seconds inch in two neighboring treads.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Working door handles or an equivalent mechanism ____.
cards.back: Working door handles or an equivalent mechanism must be present.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Damaged or displaced protruding parts that create a ____.
cards.back: Damaged or displaced protruding parts that create a safety hazard are unacceptable.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The horn must function ____.
cards.back: The horn must function for inspection.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The inspection requires a noise-reducing muffler and an ____.
cards.back: The inspection requires a noise-reducing muffler and an exhaust system without leaks.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A catalytic converter is required when the manufacturer ____.
cards.back: A catalytic converter is required when the manufacturer originally fitted one.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: No visible fuel, oil or coolant leakage is ____.
cards.back: No visible fuel, oil or coolant leakage is allowed for inspection.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Seat belts must be worn ____.
cards.back: Seat belts must be worn at inspection.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A passenger-car bumper’s bottom may be no higher than ____.
cards.back: A passenger-car bumper’s bottom may be no higher than twenty-two inches above ground.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The gap between the body and frame rail may ____.
cards.back: The gap between the body and frame rail may not exceed three inches.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A hood-mounted air scoop may not ____.
cards.back: A hood-mounted air scoop may not exceed three inches.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles from model years nineteen sixty-eight through nineteen ninety-five are ____.
cards.back: Vehicles from model years nineteen sixty-eight through nineteen ninety-five are tested for exhaust emissions.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Gas-powered vehicles from nineteen ninety-six onward weighing under eight thousand ____.
cards.back: Gas-powered vehicles from nineteen ninety-six onward weighing under eight thousand pounds receive an OBD-II test.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Gas or diesel vehicles from two thousand eight onward with GVWR from eight thousand five hundred one ____.
cards.back: Gas or diesel vehicles from two thousand eight onward with GVWR from eight thousand five hundred one to fourteen thousand receive OBD-II testing.
cards.memory_hook: to fourteen thousand receive OBD-II testing

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A windshield crack longer than five inches is ____.
cards.back: A windshield crack longer than five inches is a mandatory inspection failure.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A star chip larger than one inch is a ____.
cards.back: A star chip larger than one inch is a mandatory windshield inspection failure.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Windshield visibility height must be at ____.
cards.back: Windshield visibility height must be at least ten inches.

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles seven model years old or newer avoid inspection except a VIN ____.
cards.back: Vehicles seven model years old or newer avoid inspection except a VIN inspection if never titled in Delaware.
cards.memory_hook: inspection if never titled in Delaware

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles seven years old receive a one-year ____.
cards.back: Vehicles seven years old receive a one-year renewal without inspection.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Renewing after registration expiration incurs a twenty ____.
cards.back: Renewing after registration expiration incurs a twenty dollars late fee.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An unsafe, improperly equipped or improperly repaired vehicle is rejected and must be corrected, reinspected and passed ____.
cards.back: An unsafe, improperly equipped or improperly repaired vehicle is rejected and must be corrected, reinspected and passed before title, registration and plate issuance.
cards.memory_hook: before title, registration and plate issuance

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An owner nearing registration expiration may qualify for a twenty dollars temporary tag when the ____.
cards.back: An owner nearing registration expiration may qualify for a twenty dollars temporary tag when the inspection failure is unrelated to safety.
cards.memory_hook: inspection failure is unrelated to safety

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The third registration step is applying for a ____.
cards.back: The third registration step is applying for a Delaware title and registration.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A title certificate from a title-issuing state must be surrendered ____.
cards.back: A title certificate from a title-issuing state must be surrendered to the DMV when applying.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a lien prevents obtaining the title, the DMV provides form MV-thirty-five ____.
cards.back: When a lien prevents obtaining the title, the DMV provides form MV-thirty-five for requesting it from the lienholder.
cards.memory_hook: for requesting it from the lienholder

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After emissions and safety inspections are passed, the technician supplies the MV-two hundred ____.
cards.back: After emissions and safety inspections are passed, the technician supplies the MV-two hundred twelve title application and inspection report.
cards.memory_hook: twelve title application and inspection report

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The application requires all owners’ signatures, an authorized person with original power of ____.
cards.back: The application requires all owners’ signatures, an authorized person with original power of attorney, or a company officer’s signature.
cards.memory_hook: attorney, or a company officer’s signature

decks.domain: Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An out-of-state vehicle brought for Delaware titling or registration normally has a document fee of five point two five percent of its current NADA average trade-in ____.
cards.back: An out-of-state vehicle brought for Delaware titling or registration normally has a document fee of five point two five percent of its current NADA average trade-in value, with an eight dollars minimum.
cards.memory_hook: value, with an eight dollars minimum

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The document-fee exception requires proof of a sales, transfer or similar vehicle-purchase levy paid to another ____.
cards.back: The document-fee exception requires proof of a sales, transfer or similar vehicle-purchase levy paid to another state within the preceding ninety days.
cards.memory_hook: state within the preceding ninety days

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook gives a three point seven five percent document ____.
cards.back: The handbook gives a three point seven five percent document fee for mobile homes.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Liability-insurance proof must be provided when a vehicle ____.
cards.back: Liability-insurance proof must be provided when a vehicle is titled or registered.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The title fee without a lien ____.
cards.back: The title fee without a lien is thirty-five dollars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The title fee with a lien ____.
cards.back: The title fee with a lien is fifty-five dollars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a lien exists, the title goes to the lienholder and the ____.
cards.back: When a lien exists, the title goes to the lienholder and the customer must supply the correct address.
cards.memory_hook: customer must supply the correct address

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passenger-vehicle registration costs forty dollars for ____.
cards.back: Passenger-vehicle registration costs forty dollars for one year.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passenger-vehicle registration costs eighty dollars for ____.
cards.back: Passenger-vehicle registration costs eighty dollars for two years.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: During a vehicle’s first seven model years, its model year determines eligibility for ____.
cards.back: During a vehicle’s first seven model years, its model year determines eligibility for registration lasting one to seven years.
cards.memory_hook: registration lasting one to seven years

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Six-month registration costs ____.
cards.back: Six-month registration costs twenty-one dollars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Additional registration fees for alternative-fuel vehicles start October one, two ____.
cards.back: Additional registration fees for alternative-fuel vehicles start October one, two thousand twenty-five in the handbook.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR six thousand pounds or ____.
cards.back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR six thousand pounds or less is one hundred ten dollars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above six thousand through ten thousand ____.
cards.back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above six thousand through ten thousand pounds is one hundred fifty dollars.
cards.memory_hook: pounds is one hundred fifty dollars

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand ____.
cards.back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds is two hundred sixty dollars.
cards.memory_hook: pounds is two hundred sixty dollars

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above twenty-six ____.
cards.back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above twenty-six thousand pounds is nine hundred dollars.
cards.memory_hook: thousand pounds is nine hundred dollars

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR six thousand ____.
cards.back: The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR six thousand pounds or less is eighty-five dollars.
cards.memory_hook: pounds or less is eighty-five dollars

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR above six thousand through ten thousand ____.
